question: In which of the following plants do roots arise from parts of a plant other than the radicle?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Monstera**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Monstera develops aerial roots that grow from the **stem and branches**, rather than from the** radicle**, allowing it to climb and stabilize itself.
 
• These roots help the plant anchor itself, absorb moisture from the air, and gather nutrients from its environment.
 
• Monstera exhibits a vining growth habit, using aerial roots to cling to nearby structures and reach **sunlight in its natural habitat.**<
